agent.name: Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Contextual adoption posture and decision triggers

analytical_question: What adoption action is appropriate now for the retailer's weekly reporting application?
general_et_finding: Generative AI has demonstrated benefits in some work settings and task-dependent errors. Broad U.S. workplace uptake is a diffusion signal, not evidence of fitness for a particular organization. No current vendor or model is evaluated.
application_finding: Drafting narratives from verified tables is a plausible use, but correctness and total effort have not been demonstrated locally. Manual templates and deterministic BI summaries are available alternatives.
organization_specific_finding: The moderate retailer can consider an experiment because the assumed evaluation environment, reviewers, quarantine and fallback make learning reversible. Operational adoption is not yet justified.

evidence.claim: Study of 5,172 customer-support agents reports 15% average increase in issues resolved per hour; effects differ across workers.
evidence.notes: Historical single-firm customer-support setting; not current retail-reporting accuracy, a local ROI forecast or a vendor/model guarantee. Use final publication, not 2023 working-paper figures of 5,179 and 14%.

evidence.claim: Randomized study of 758 consultants found task-dependent gains and harm. On one outside-frontier task, combined AI groups were approximately 19 percentage points less likely to be correct.
evidence.date_or_recency: 2026-03-11 online; experiment used June 2023 GPT-4; checked 2026-11-01
evidence.notes: A single difficult task in an earlier model setting; not a universal error rate for 2026 tools. Body specifies percentage points; avoid treating the abstract wording as a relative percentage.

evidence.claim: Voluntary guidance supports empirical capability evaluation, deployment-relevant testing and limits on extrapolation from narrow assessments.
evidence.notes: Risk-management guidance, not law, a compliance certificate, or proof that the hypothetical organization is ready. Numerical experiment gates below are analyst proposals, not NIST thresholds.

evidence.claim: Q3 2026: 40.54550% of U.S. employed adults aged 18-64 report using generative AI for work; Q2: 45.19932%.
evidence.date_or_recency: Updated 2026-10-20; observations Q3 2026 and Q2 2026; checked 2026-11-01
evidence.notes: Self-reported workers, not retail firms or the reporting task. Not seasonally adjusted; not retained-user cohorts, local benefit, or an automatic adopter-category threshold. Data may be revised.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: No measured retail reporting benefit or exact model capability.
The organization and controls are hypothetical intake assumptions, not verified organizational readiness.
Study findings do not generalize automatically to this task.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in experimenting under the stated safeguards; low confidence in net benefit or readiness to deploy.
value_opportunity_implication: The experiment can discover whether drafting help saves net work compared with the present process.
risk_governance_implication: Keep human review and quarantine, exclude sensitive data and retain manual reporting. Organizational Adoption should assess implementation ownership and sustained capacity.
recommendation_management_implication: Conduct an experiment over the next four weeks. Compare AI-assisted reports with manual reports, checking accuracy, speed and reviewer effort. Do not authorize a company-wide rollout.
change_monitoring_triggers: Expand consideration if quality is acceptable and time savings are meaningful.
Pause if errors or governance problems arise.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Confirm model version, cost and the operating safeguards before starting.
More local performance evidence is needed before adoption.
